headline: NumbersGame adds Stripe, Square and Ramp to its QuickBooks Online and Xero MCP for accounting firms using Claude or ChatGPT
so_what: An add-on now plugs a firm's own Claude or ChatGPT into every client QuickBooks or Xero file — and it just learned Stripe, Square and Ramp. The AI drafts payout entries, revenue-recognition journals and reconciliations across all client books in one conversation; a person approves anything that posts. The drafting layer of bookkeeping is being automated in the open — the paid skill is reviewing drafts and catching what they got wrong.
reason: an AI add-on now drafts Stripe, Square and Ramp entries straight into QuickBooks and Xero — the prep work is automated, a person still approves every post

task.title: Connect one client file to an AI assistant (Claude or ChatGPT) and check one payout entry it drafts before it posts

headline: LoKation Real Estate partners with Lundy to launch Jefe, a custom AI assistant for every LoKation agent
so_what: LoKation, a brokerage across six states, now gives every agent Jefe — a voice-first AI that runs the CRM, the transaction platform, email and calendar by voice or text. When the brokerage itself hands every agent an AI that does the follow-up, the unaided agent is the one at a disadvantage. The human work that stays scarce: negotiation, pricing judgment, local advice.
reason: a six-state brokerage now gives every agent a voice AI that runs the CRM, email and follow-ups — assisted agents are the new baseline

task.title: Set up one AI follow-up routine in your CRM — or ask your brokerage which AI assistant it provides — and let it run this week's lead follow-ups

headline: Adobe launches Adobe for Startups: free 12-month creative and productivity suite for early-stage founders
so_what: Adobe now gives eligible startups — founded within the last five years, under $15M raised — 12 free months of Firefly Pro Plus, Acrobat Studio with Express Premium, and Semrush. If you run your own young studio, that is a real year of pro AI tooling at zero cost, worth an application before paying for another plan.
reason: Adobe gives eligible young studios a free year of its pro AI suite — Firefly Pro Plus, Express Premium and Semrush

task.title: Check whether your studio qualifies for Adobe for Startups and apply — 12 months of Firefly Pro Plus free if you do
